Recorded at v4560.

*** THIS IS A REFERENCE, NOT A DEPENDENCY. NOTHING IN THE ENGINE LOADS IT. ***

xatlas is C++ and there is no emscripten in this sandbox, so it cannot ship to the browser --
clang++ and g++ ARE here, so it can be BUILT AND RUN natively, and that is what it is for. The
engine's own unwrapper, physics/mesh/uvLscm.mjs, welds, segments into charts and solves LSCM:
the same pipeline in miniature. Until now it was graded only against itself and against
properties it asserted about its own output. xatlas is the reference implementation of that
pipeline, so it can be run on the SAME mesh and the two outputs scored by ONE metric.

WHAT IS VENDORED: the two files of the core library and its licence. Not the repository --
no models/, no bin/, no premake5.lua, no thirdparty. The two files are self-contained: they
compile with `g++ -O2 -std=c++11` and no other dependency, which is checked rather than
claimed (tools/mesh/xatlasRef.mjs builds them on demand and SKIPS when no compiler is present).
